<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Christmas Decoration House Map — November 2026</title><style>
:root{--pine:#1b4c3f;--pine2:#286352;--ink:#26342e;--muted:#6b736b;--soft:#f4f4ed;--line:#d9dfd8;--gold:#c69a51}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;font:15px/1.48 system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:#f6f5f0}button,input,select{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}
header{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#103629,#276454);color:white;padding:24px 25px}header h1{margin:0;font-size:clamp(25px,4vw,42px)}header p{margin:5px 0;color:#e2f1e8}.stats{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:11px}.stat{padding:5px 13px;border:1px solid #7eab90;border-radius:19px;font-size:13px}
main{max-width:1450px;padding:20px;margin:auto}.note{background:#fff9eb;border-left:4px solid var(--gold);border-radius:8px;padding:11px 14px;margin-bottom:16px}h2{margin:0;font-size:20px}.light{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.tabs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;margin:0 0 16px}.tabs button,.actions button{border-radius:8px;padding:9px 13px;border:1px solid #ccdbcf;background:white;color:#255644}.tabs .active{background:var(--pine);color:#fff}
.panel{background:white;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:16px;margin:12px 0;box-shadow:0 2px 8px #0e302308}.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,2fr) minmax(260px,1fr);gap:15px}.areas{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}.area{background:#eaf4ee;border:2px solid #aec7bb;border-radius:13px;padding:12px;min-height:260px}.area:nth-child(2){background:#edf1fa;border-color:#c0cbe0}.area:nth-child(3){background:#fff7e8;border-color:#e6d0a8}.area:nth-child(4){background:#f2f0ee;border-color:#d7d2ca}.area h3{font-size:16px;margin:2px 0 10px}.room-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px}.room-tile{border:1px solid #adc3b5;background:#ffffffb5;text-align:left;border-radius:10px;padding:11px;min-height:75px}.room-tile:hover,.room-tile.active{background:#d6eae0;border-color:var(--pine2)}.room-tile b{display:block;font-size:14px}.room-tile span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.controls{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;align-items:center}.controls input{padding:11px;border:1px solid #bfccc2;border-radius:9px;min-width:220px;flex:1}.controls select{padding:10px;border:1px solid #bfccc2;border-radius:9px}.actions{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.photo-tabs{display:flex;gap:7px;overflow-x:auto;padding:8px 0}.photo-tabs button{border:1px solid #cad5ca;border-radius:7px;background:#eff4ef;color:#285742;padding:7px 10px;white-space:nowrap;font-size:12px}.photo-tabs button.active{background:var(--pine);color:white}
.photo{width:100%;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#e8e7e0;border-radius:10px}.photo img{width:100%;display:block;height:auto}.pin{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border:2px solid white;color:#fff;background:#ba443b;border-radius:100%;width:31px;height:31px;font-size:10px;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 2px 7px #0019}.pin:hover,.pin.selected{background:#116d8b;z-index:2;scale:1.18}.pin.hidden{opacity:.18}.pin:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffb73f}
.rows{max-height:620px;overflow-y:auto;margin-top:7px}.item{padding:11px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #e8ede8;cursor:pointer;border-radius:7px}.item:hover,.item.active{background:#eef4ef}.item strong{font-size:13px;color:#215746}.item span{font-size:12px;display:block;color:#67736a}.detail p{margin:9px 0}.detail input,.detail textarea{width:100%;padding:8px;margin-top:4px;border:1px solid #cfd8d0;border-radius:7px}.detail label{display:block;font-size:13px;margin:9px 0}.detail button{border:1px solid #a7bdac;background:#e8f3e9;border-radius:7px;padding:8px 12px}.badge{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;border-radius:20px;background:#e9f0e7;padding:3px 8px;margin:4px 2px 2px 0}.warn{background:#fff0df;color:#855d25}
#table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:13px}#table td,#table th{border-bottom:1px solid #e3e8e3;padding:10px 8px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top}#table th{position:sticky;top:0;background:#f0f6ef;z-index:1}.scrolltable{max-height:70vh;overflow:auto}.video-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(190px,1fr));gap:12px}.video-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;padding:9px}.video-card img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/11;object-fit:contain;background:#f3f3ed;border-radius:6px}.tiny{font-size:12px;color:#65746b}.footer{padding:22px 0;color:#69776e;font-size:12px}
@media(max-width:930px){.two{grid-template-columns:1fr}.areas{grid-template-columns:1fr}.room-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.rows{max-height:360px}}@media print{header{color:black;background:white}.tabs,.actions,.controls{display:none!important}.panel{box-shadow:none;break-inside:avoid}.photo img{max-height:580px;object-fit:contain}body{background:white}}

/* Image-backed inventory */
.inventory-photo{width:72px;height:72px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:9px;display:block;background:#eaeae5}
.inventory-photo-btn{border:1px solid #c8d7cb;border-radius:10px;padding:2px;background:#fff;cursor:zoom-in;transition:transform .12s,box-shadow .12s}
.inventory-photo-btn:hover,.inventory-photo-btn:focus-visible{transform:scale(1.04);box-shadow:0 3px 10px #173d273b;outline:2px solid #27785e}
.inventory-name{font-weight:650;color:var(--ink);max-width:330px;min-width:130px;line-height:1.4}
.inventory-name .subtext{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:400}
#table th:first-child,#table td:first-child{width:86px}
.item{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center}.list-item-thumb{height:48px;width:48px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:7px;flex:none}.item-copy{flex:1;min-width:0}
#photo-dialog{width:min(94vw,1030px);max-height:90vh;overflow:auto;border:1px solid #b9c9b9;border-radius:17px;padding:0;box-shadow:0 20px 70px #0007;color:var(--ink)}
#photo-dialog::backdrop{background:#0b1a16ba;backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}
.dialog-head{padding:15px 19px;border-bottom:1px solid #e5e9e4;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:start;background:#f4f8f3;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:4}
.dialog-head h3{margin:0;font-size:20px}.dialog-head p{margin:3px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.dialog-close{height:38px;min-width:38px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #ccddca;background:#fff;font-size:24px;line-height:1}
.dialog-body{padding:17px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.3fr);gap:17px}
.dialog-photo-card{min-width:0}.dialog-photo-card h4{margin:0 0 7px;color:var(--pine)}
.dialog-crop{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;max-height:440px;object-fit:contain;background:#e8e9e5;border-radius:11px}
.dialog-context{position:relative}.dialog-context img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:480px;object-fit:contain;background:#e8e9e5;border-radius:11px}
.dialog-context .target-pin{position:absolute;z-index:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);height:27px;width:27px;border-radius:50%;background:#d53a3a;color:white;border:2px solid white;box-shadow:0 1px 5px #0009;font-weight:bold;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;pointer-events:none}
.dialog-actions{padding:0 18px 18px;display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:12px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.dialog-actions button{background:#e5f1e9;border:1px solid #9fb9a8;color:#164b35;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font-weight:600}
.dialog-meta{padding:0 18px 12px;font-size:13px;color:#53685b}
@media(max-width:750px){#table th:nth-child(4),#table td:nth-child(4),#table th:nth-child(6),#table td:nth-child(6){display:none}#table td,#table th{padding:8px 5px}.inventory-photo{width:62px;height:62px}.dialog-body{grid-template-columns:1fr}.dialog-crop{max-height:310px}.dialog-context img{max-height:340px}}
.dialog-context img{max-height:none;object-fit:fill!important}@media(max-width:750px){.dialog-context img{max-height:none}}</style></head><body>
<header><h1>🎄 Christmas Decoration House Map</h1><p>2026 setup · Walkthrough-linked rooms, numbered photo markers and editable item inventory</p><div class="stats"><span class="stat">167 labeled decorations & display components</span><span class="stat">23 display locations</span><span class="stat">40 photographs + 2 walkthroughs</span><span class="stat">167 item photo close-ups</span></div></header>
<main><div class="note"><b>Mapping status:</b> The two walkthroughs confirm relative grouping of furnishings and decorations, including the TV tree, two-window garland, kitchen doorway and closet. This is a <b>schematic, not a measured architectural floor plan</b>. The cream-wall TV area is kept separate from the salmon-wall fireplace area; bench and writing-desk locations remain unconfirmed. Stockings are separately logged. Repeated images of the same item have been deduplicated.</div>
<div class="tabs"><button class="active" data-page="house" onclick="showPage('house')">⌂ House map</button><button data-page="photos" onclick="showPage('photos')">📍 Photo pins</button><button data-page="inventory" onclick="showPage('inventory')">☷ Full inventory</button><button data-page="evidence" onclick="showPage('evidence')">▶ Video evidence</button></div>
<div class="panel controls"><input id="search" placeholder="Search IDs, ornaments, rooms, locations…" aria-label="Search items"><div class="actions"><button id="csv">Export updated CSV</button><button id="json">Export editable JSON</button><button onclick="window.print()">Print</button><button id="reset-edits">Reset edits</button></div></div>
<section id="page-house"><section class="panel"><h2>House layout · working room map</h2><p id="house-desc" class="light"></p><div id="house-grid"></div></section><p class="light">Select a display to open its reference photos with numbered item markers. Living room = sofa, mantel and coffee table. Dining / display area = village sideboard and china hutch. Window locations and uncertain rooms are kept separate to avoid invented placements.</p></section>
<section id="page-photos" hidden><section class="panel"><div class="controls"><select id="zone-select" aria-label="Select display area"></select><span id="itemcount" class="light"></span></div><h2 id="selected-zone"></h2><p id="zone-metadata" class="light"></p><div id="photos-tabs" class="photo-tabs"></div><div class="two"><div><div class="photo" id="photo-holder"><img id="main-photo" alt="Reference photo of the selected decoration display"><div id="pin-layer"></div></div><p class="tiny">Pin numbers correspond to each ID's suffix in the inventory. Select a marker to see the decoration and its exact recorded location. To correct a pin, select the decoration and enable position editing below.</p><div class="actions"><button id="edit-pins">Edit marker positions</button></div><div class="panel detail" id="detail"></div></div><aside><div class="panel"><h2>Display inventory</h2><div id="items-list" class="rows"></div></div></aside></div></section></section>
<section id="page-inventory" hidden><section class="panel"><h2>Every identifiable decoration — with photo thumbnails</h2><p class="light" id="inventory-total"></p><div class="scrolltable"><table id="table"><thead><tr><th>Image</th><th>ID</th><th>Decoration</th><th>Display</th><th>Position on furniture</th><th>Home location</th><th>Confidence<br>photo / location</th></tr></thead><tbody id="table-body"></tbody></table></div></section></section>
<section id="page-evidence" hidden><section class="panel"><h2>Walkthrough video cross-reference</h2><p class="light">Approximate timestamps from the 86.6-second first walkthrough and 17.1-second second walkthrough. These are visual checkpoints, not GPS or survey measurements.</p><div id="evidence-list" class="video-grid"></div></section></section>

<dialog id="photo-dialog" aria-labelledby="dialog-item-heading" onclick="if(event.target===this)this.close()">
 <div class="dialog-head"><div><h3 id="dialog-item-heading"></h3><p id="dialog-item-location"></p></div><button class="dialog-close" type="button" aria-label="Close picture" onclick="document.getElementById('photo-dialog').close()">×</button></div>
 <div class="dialog-body">
  <div class="dialog-photo-card"><h4>Individual item close-up</h4><img id="dialog-item-crop" class="dialog-crop" alt="Close-up photograph of the decoration"><p class="tiny">Automatically cropped from your original photo. Some nearby objects may be visible.</p></div>
  <div class="dialog-photo-card"><h4>Where it sits in the arrangement</h4><div id="dialog-item-context" class="dialog-context"><img id="dialog-item-full" alt="Full reference photograph of the display"><div id="dialog-item-pin" class="target-pin">●</div></div><p class="tiny" id="dialog-item-src"></p></div>
 </div><div id="dialog-item-meta" class="dialog-meta"></div>
 <div class="dialog-actions"><button type="button" onclick="document.getElementById('photo-dialog').close();choose(window.previewId)">View on photo map</button><button type="button" onclick="document.getElementById('photo-dialog').close()">Close</button></div>
</dialog>
<div class="footer">Offline, self-contained map. Images remain embedded in this HTML file; changes to labels and pin locations save locally in the browser and can be exported with the buttons above. Prepared 22 November 2026.</div></main><script>
const THUMBS={"BEN-01":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","BEN-02":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","BEN-03":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","BEN-04":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","BEN-05":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","BEN-06":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","VIL-01":"data:image/jpeg;base64,","VIL-02":"data:image/jpeg;base64,
